semantic.justification: J0Z0KF ports original AttributeConversion::decodeXString, its literal/hex pointer scan and comphelper::string::sanitizeStringSurrogates, plus actual FastAttributeList counted UTF8 Unicode values and optional/defaulted AttributeList string/XString queries. RichStringPortion owns decoded actual SAL Unicode text; RichString preserves ordered text/run portions, attributes and concatenation. Native lowercase-x and four-hex-unit recognition, one-pass underscore escaping, no-marker COW fast paths, marker-triggered first-invalid-surrogate truncation, first-duplicate attributes, missing versus empty and undecoded fallback defaults are retained. Private preserve-space state uses a monotone boolean assignment equivalent to setting true; its unused downstream native role is not repaired with whitespace trimming or a new public getter. Font/phonetic/binary/UNO/edit-engine conversion and finalization, RichStringContext/SharedStringsBuffer, workbook helpers/filter and shell/UI acceptance remain unported. Local direct model-write tests do not claim XLSX parse/import, shared-string lookup, rich formatting, XML context orchestration or independent native compilation. J0Z0KF connects original FastTokenHandlerBase direct lookup, borrowed handler/copy/clone propagation and actual FastTokenHandler to native FastAttributeList token/value/numeric/view queries. Optional/defaulted AttributeList token, integer/double/unsigned/hyper/hex/bool results delegate to these owners and existing real SAL/o3tl parsers. Original byte-view toDouble is added beside UTF16 without host parseFloat/Number replacement. Native missing output zeroing, untouched missing view, first duplicates, present unknown token retaining invalid despite default, present invalid/empty signed numeric zero, unsigned/hyper/hex empty absence, signed64-then-unsigned saturation, unsigned-hex signed cast and boolean exact/token/numeric fallbacks are retained. No fake token handler, injected result map, temporary parser facade, null-handler token-call witness or native null-pointer/ABI claim is introduced. Original FastTokenHandlerBase WeakImplHelper/XFastTokenHandler service registration, complete SAX/attribute APIs, independently compiled original numeric/attribute differential and complete workbook/filter/model/UI acceptance remain unported or unverified. Original AttributeList constructor now accepts actual Reference<XFastAttributeList>, performs original castToFastAttributeList and holds actual rtl::Reference<FastAttributeList>; native intrusive owner survives caller UNO release and original getFastAttributeList returns the same borrowed const handle. All consumed getters dereference this actual owner and destruction releases it. Existing source-related attribute/RichString callers migrated to proper actual references and explicit lifetime; old raw wrapper borrowing is removed. All prior token/string/numeric/boolean/default logic is unchanged. Actual positive native RelationsFragment consumes the owning helper under C SAX callbacks; retained owner mutation/independent copied-reference lifetime are tested without a fake list/provider. Original optional/defaulted getDateTime now uses the actual generated DateTime value, byte-view length/separator checks, original o3tl conversions and unsigned16 assignments; IsUTC and NanoSeconds retain source defaults, including uppercase Z. Original getTokenList consumes counted byte views through the actual o3tl size_t-position specialization and real TokenMap, preserving empty/unknown identities, exact space delimiters and ordered duplicates. No host Date, whitespace splitting, repaired UTC/calendar validation, fake attributes or replacement token provider is used. Drawing-color, full model/filter/UI acceptance and independently compiled original differential remain unqualified.
